THE IRON TEST

A brutal 6×5 cluster slot with cascading symbols, persistent Heat Zones and escalating multipliers. Every visual and sound belongs to the same underground training world.

Fake credits only. No deposits, withdrawals or prizes.

TRAININGS: THE IRON TEST

Clusters of five or more matching symbols connected horizontally or vertically pay. WILD can join any normal symbol. Winning symbols are removed and new symbols cascade into the grid.

  • Heat Zones are created from winning positions and begin at x2.
  • When a winning cluster touches an existing Heat Zone, its multiplier is added to that payout.
  • Reusing the same Heat Zone upgrades it through x2, x3, x5, x8, x12 and x20.
  • Three TEST symbols trigger 8 free rounds; four trigger 10; five or more trigger 12.
  • Heat Zones persist between free rounds.
  • Intensity costs 3× the selected bet and increases TEST and Heat frequency.
